claims.originating_goal: Provide a current-iPhone browser-local App Store Connect credential ingress that reuses the existing TV/TVC + InTr + SKAP sealed-custody path and never exposes Apple credential material to Site, GitHub Actions, repository state, logs, or chat.
claims.claim_expires_when: Release only after App Store Connect browser-local sealing, ciphertext-only submission, fail-closed recipient/route gating, credential-field clearing, focused validation, and exact TVC dependency bindings are merged; real credential ingress remains separately evidence-gated.
expected_evidence: browser-local issuer/key/p8 bundle is sealed with P-256 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM
recipient key and route projection remain fail-closed until TVC runtime evidence exists
plaintext Apple credential fields are absent from outbound packet and durable browser storage
ambiguous submission requires external verification and prohibits blind retry
GitHub Actions validation receives no Apple credential material
real credential SKAP custody is not claimed from source validation
collision_boundaries: Reuse existing SKAP browser-ingress semantics; do not create a generalized credential framework
Do not alter unrelated StegFin/Coinbase credential lanes
Do not introduce repository or workflow custody for issuer ID, key ID, p8, JWT, or provider token
Do not weaken TV/TVC + InTr + SKAP boundaries
No automatic provider operation from successful custody
claims.next_task_after_release: TVC publishes an active App Store Connect recipient/route projection, then owner iPhone performs browser-local sealing and SKAP admission of the already-created Apple Team key.
